reason: Calls one Bitrix24 method by its API name, the same command gcal-cli and drive-cli have; no shared verb names a raw API call. Review when the vocabulary names it: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/425

Names the owner's own Bitrix24 local application by its ID, the way gcal-cli's session start --client-id names the owner's Google client (WC-SECR-25); a local application exists only in one portal, so no WireCat app can stand in. Review when the vocabulary names an app credential: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/424

Names the portal the local application lives in, which the browser sign-in must open before any token exists; a webhook carries its portal in its address, so only the application sign-in needs it. Review with --client-id when the vocabulary names an app credential: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/424
The issues link in src/identity.ts, printed for the person to open; b24 never sends a request there, and hostFetch would refuse one.
